recipes.title: Chicken wing toss sauce
recipes.description: Simple glaze/toss sauce for chicken wings.
steps: Mix yuzu sauce and mirin 1:1, then toss the chicken wings in the sauce.

recipes.title: Indo chicken air fry
recipes.description: 懶人版印尼烤雞撈麵 - lazy air-fryer ayam bakar with indomie.
steps: Do not cook the noodles first (we don't want soggy indomie).
Place the chicken into a bowl.
Add the light soy sauce, kecap manis, chilli oil, garlic oil, white pepper, salt, and half of the spring onions.
Rub the marinade all over the chicken until evenly coated.
Marinate for 1 hour.
Air fry at 180°C for 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until the skin is caramelised and slightly charred.
While the chicken rests, cook the indomie per the package instructions, then drain.
Mix the noodles with the seasoning packets and stir well.
Plate the indomie and top with the air-fried chicken.
Drizzle with sambal, garnish with the remaining spring onions, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: 可樂雞翼
recipes.description: 可樂雞翼 - Coca-Cola chicken wings.
steps: Dry pan-fry the chicken wings until golden on both sides; set aside.
In the wok, sauté ginger and scallion until fragrant, then add the wings back in.
Add cola to cover the wings, plus soy sauce and cooking wine; cover and cook about 10 minutes.
Tidy up and plate.

recipes.title: 蔥油雞撈飯
recipes.description: 蔥油雞撈飯 - scallion-oil chicken over rice.
ingredients: Marinade: oyster sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper, wine
steps: Marinate the diced chicken thigh in oyster sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper, and wine for 30 minutes.
Dice the scallion and ginger and mix with the sugar and salt.
Heat oil and pour it over the scallion-ginger mix (don't use too much oil or it will be greasy).
In a rice cooker, add the diced chicken thigh on top of the rice and cook the rice.
When done, transfer to a pot, mix all the rice with the sauce, and cook 3 minutes until combined.
Alternative method: blend all the sauce together.

recipes.title: 雞腿肉 & 青瓜薄片配麻辣醬汁
recipes.description: 雞腿肉 & 青瓜薄片配麻辣醬汁 - poached chicken thigh with cucumber ribbons in mala (spicy) sauce.
ingredients: 雞腿肉 / Chicken leg, 1 large piece
Sauce: 李錦記麻辣紅油 / Lee Kum Kee mala chili oil, 1 tsp
Sauce: Mizkan sushi vinegar, 1.5 tsp (already sweet, so no added sugar; adjust to taste)
steps: Cook the chicken: place it in cold water with the scallion, ginger, and cooking wine.
Bring to a boil, reduce to low, cover, and cook 10 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let it steep 15 minutes.
Make the sauce: mix all the sauce ingredients together.
Shave the cucumber into thin ribbons.
Slice the chicken and lay it over the cucumber.
Drizzle with the mala sauce and serve.
Tip: don't discard the chicken broth - it can be drunk as soup.
Tip: to keep the cucumber from releasing too much water, salt the shaved cucumber, rest 10 minutes, drain, then plate.
